title: Fair outputs, Biased Internals: Causal Potency and Asymmetry of Latent Bias in LLMs for High-Stakes Decisions

bias_targets.methodology: Matched-pair audit design using synthetic mortgage applications with counterfactual substitution of racially-associated names (Black vs. White names) to evaluate behavioral output fairness, alongside representational analysis, activation steering of internal model states, prompt engineering, and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA).
